notes: Selection quantizes before cutting: score_q=round_half_even(1000*float64(score)) over all passages, then order (-score_q, passage_key UTF-8) and keep k (1..50). The design text (top 50 by float, then quantize) lets a float cut split a score_q tie.

bm25s BM25.index() on a list of token-string lists builds its vocab from a set, so ids depend on PYTHONHASHSEED; this build uses first-appearance ids (bm25s.tokenize semantics) and is byte-identical to bm25s.tokenize+BM25.index (tested).

Index built by a streaming numpy replica of bm25s 0.3.14 build_index_from_ids (stock path needs per-token Python lists; ~5x the RAM). Files written by bm25s save(); load with bm25s.BM25.load(mmap=True|False).
Indexed/displayed/hashed passage content is title + newline + text. FEVER PTB escapes (-LRB- etc.) decoded; FEVER page ids may contain colons.

wiki-pages.zip contains __MACOSX/._*.jsonl resource forks; only wiki-pages/wiki-NNN.jsonl members are read. The zip was deleted after extraction; its sha256 is in source.sha256 and the passages hash was re-derived from it in a second process before deletion.

index_sha256 covers file hashes, tokenizer config, BM25 params, corpus_sha256, and versions (python major.minor, unicodedata, bm25s, numpy, scipy, orjson presence: bm25s writes vocab with orjson if installed).
